CAP-DATA-01.title: golden-reference network built two different ways (programmatic vs .inp-file-loaded) diverges by structural hash
CAP-DATA-01.measured_effect: top1 0.95 (scenario-hash arm) vs 0.85 (production-hash arm), classical_prior mean abs diff 0.44 (N=20); replication set: identical qualitative pattern (N=20 fresh).

CAP-CAL-01.title: Direct consequence of CAP-DATA-01: golden-reference network hash is absent from validated_topology_hashes at serving time
CAP-CAL-01.measured_effect: 231/264 (87.5%) of the real LIVE post-remediation campaign runs against golden-reference; calibrated_rate=0.0% for all of them (verified directly against reports/evaluation/live-robustness/post-remediation-results.json this session). loop-grid (9/264, no construction-path asymmetry) is 100% calibrated -- exact match to the predicted pattern.

CAP-OOD-01.title: Same network-hash mismatch (CAP-DATA-01) forces OOD=CAUTION for every golden-reference LIVE incident via a hard override, independent of any real distributional anomaly
CAP-OOD-01.source: src/hydroswarm/inference/ood.py:44-49 (topology_novelty returns 1.0 whenever network_hash not in validated_network_hashes) and line 128 (`if network_novelty > 0 and level == OODLevel.NORMAL: level = OODLevel.CAUTION`) -- read and confirmed directly this session, not from a subagent report.
CAP-OOD-01.measured_effect: All 12 real LIVE nominal:clean_operational records (perturbation_type=nominal, the closest analog to a clean controlled scenario) show ood_level=CAUTION, never NORMAL -- verified directly against reports/evaluation/live-robustness/post-remediation-results.json this session. This is the SAME root cause as CAP-CAL-01, manifesting through a second, independent gate (OOD) via validated_network_hashes being derived from the identical calibration artifact's validated_topology_hashes. Together CAP-DATA-01/CAP-CAL-01/CAP-OOD-01 form a single causal chain: one float-precision network-hash mismatch simultaneously defeats both suppression gates for 87.5% of LIVE traffic.

CAP-CAL-02.title: Mondrian (per-network, per-condition) conformal scores are unreachable at runtime; candidate_set always falls back to pooled global scores
CAP-CAL-02.measured_effect: Real call site passes network_id=str(getattr(network,'name','unknown')) (e.g. 'hydroswarm-demo') against an artifact keyed by clean corpus family names, and never passes condition= at all -- confirmed by direct source inspection. Secondary to CAP-CAL-01 (does not by itself explain near-zero planning eligibility) but means even a CAP-CAL-01 fix would not deliver the artifact's intended per-condition precision.

CAP-PARITY-01.title: Production health channel does not reflect missing==True
CAP-PARITY-01.measured_effect: 60 affected (node,timestep) cells across 17/20 fresh scenarios; also corrupts node_features' current-health snapshot column on 4/20 scenarios when a node's latest reading is missing.

CAP-PARITY-02.title: HybridInferencePipeline.analyze's feature_building stage never passes window_steps, silently defaulting to 12 instead of training's full-trajectory length (25)
CAP-PARITY-02.measured_effect: Confirmed via direct tensor shape divergence ([1,25,...] vs [1,12,...]) under mathematically-equivalent full evidence. Rarely binds today given current LIVE evidence sparsity (CAP-TEMPORAL-01 below dominates), but would independently start truncating evidence the moment incidents carry >12 real observations.

CAP-TEMPORAL-01.title: LIVE robustness harness sends exactly ONE observation per sensor (last valid reading only) as initial incident evidence, vs training's full 25-timestep/24-hour trajectory
CAP-TEMPORAL-01.measured_effect: LATEST-k evidence stays flat/noisy (top1 0.15-0.35) for k=1..12 while CAUSAL-PREFIX (earliest-k, a real growing trajectory) reaches top1=1.0 by just 6 timesteps and full-25 reaches 0.95-1.0. The single-last-reading policy is close to the LEAST informative evidence choice available for this system's classical signature matching, which depends on contamination-onset dynamics a late-window slice misses. Confirmed on an independent fresh 40-scenario holdout: latest-1 top1=0.05 vs full-trajectory top1=1.0.
CAP-TEMPORAL-01.note: This is a harness/product evidence-policy choice, not a code defect per se -- classified CAP-TEMPORAL (evidence-history/timing mismatch) per the taxonomy, distinct from CAP-HARNESS (which would imply the measurement itself is wrong rather than the evidence-content choice).

CAP-SAMPLE-01.title: Active-sampling EIG scoring and the LIVE harness's actual sample-acquisition behavior diverge on two independent axes
CAP-SAMPLE-01.source: reports/evaluation/capability-diagnostic/sampling-analysis.json; src/hydroswarm/sampling/active.py (rank_sample_locations has no time-of-observation parameter, assumes Gaussian noise std=0.05mg/L); src/hydroswarm/evaluation/live_robustness.py (harness always samples at end-of-24h-horizon with zero added noise)
CAP-SAMPLE-01.measured_effect: Confirmed empirically: with sensor_count reduced to 2 (default golden-reference sensor_count=4 already saturates all candidates, making sampling structurally unreachable at default config -- a related, secondary finding), every recommended sample's real concentration came back exactly 0.0 mg/L (end-of-horizon decay), yet entropy still dropped ~0.88 bits on average from the informative null reading; top1 stayed 0/5. Distinct from, and secondary to, CAP-TEMPORAL-01 -- but the pre-existing 300-scenario classical_eig-vs-random comparison (reports/results/v4/pre-freeze-implementation-handoff.md, cited not re-run) already shows real classical EIG beats random on a fair operational metric (69.7% vs 61.0% resolved-within-3), so the sampling ALGORITHM itself is not the primary problem -- its assumptions about WHEN a sample is taken diverge from what this specific harness does.

CAP-DATA-02.title: training/permutation.py's mask-key tuples omit sensor_mask/quality_mask, producing internally-inconsistent permuted examples
CAP-DATA-02.measured_effect: Not invoked anywhere in the real training loop today (dormant). After correcting the permutation locally within the diagnostic script only (no production files touched), the real model IS genuinely node-order equivariant across all 3 governed families (~1e-6 max diff, 30/30 agreement) -- this bug does NOT explain any of the LIVE gap; flagged only because it would silently corrupt any future permutation-augmentation training run.

not_supported.pressure_representation: Fixed 25m pressure (matching the real LIVE harness exactly) does NOT measurably distort top1 (0.80 vs 0.80 true-pressure baseline, N=15) -- ruled out as a primary driver.
not_supported.sensor_series_reconstruction: All 7 tested cases (multi-sensor-per-node merge, grab-sample-at-new-node, out-of-order timestamps, delayed/missing interleaving) behave correctly -- no spurious duplicate-series defect.
not_supported.classical_prior_distribution_shift: Coastal (unseen) topology's runtime-generated prior is NOT degenerate (JS divergence from governed-topology shape = 0.0089, far closer than either-vs-uniform's 0.11-0.196).
not_supported.node_order_permutation_bug_in_deployed_m: The real frozen model IS genuinely node-order equivariant (see CAP-DATA-02 above -- the apparent bug was in unused diagnostic/training tooling, not the deployed model).
not_supported.tensor_nondeterminism: 10 stored validation examples run 3x each are bit-identical across repeats.
not_supported.observability_ceiling: No confusable source-node pairs found on golden-reference (closest pair distance 108.5, clearly distinct peak magnitudes) -- current localization failures are not explained by fundamental physical unobservability.
not_supported.neural_capacity: 4.18M-parameter model reproduces its documented controlled-eval range exactly; classified DISTRIBUTION-SHIFTED (not underfit) given strong validation/development-holdout numbers alongside the concrete construction-path and evidence-content defects found; oracle-perfect classical prior substitution only adds +0.10 top1 over an already-high full-trajectory baseline (0.90->1.0), showing limited headroom from that specific component.

root_cause_ranking.evidence_strength: Very high -- direct causal experiment (temporal ablation) plus independent confirmation-holdout replication, both showing top1 collapsing from ~0.95-1.0 (full trajectory) to 0.15-0.35 (last-reading-only) on the SAME frozen model/weights.
root_cause_ranking.estimated_contribution_to_poor_live_util: Dominant driver of the raw top-1/top-3/MRR localization gap (controlled 0.72 vs LIVE 0.31).
root_cause_ranking.remediation_cost: LOW -- harness/product change only (send real recent history instead of one snapshot); no model or calibration change required.
root_cause_ranking.likely_impact: Very high -- this alone plausibly recovers most of the raw localization gap.

root_cause_ranking.cause: Network-identity construction mismatch cascading into calibration and OOD suppression (CAP-DATA-01 / CAP-CAL-01 / CAP-OOD-01)
root_cause_ranking.evidence_strength: Very high -- one root cause verified three independent ways (two independent subagent investigations converging + this session's direct hand-verification), cross-checked exactly against the real 264-run LIVE dataset (golden-reference 0% calibrated, loop-grid 100%; all 12 nominal LIVE records show OOD=CAUTION never NORMAL), and replicated on a fresh confirmation holdout.
root_cause_ranking.estimated_contribution_to_poor_live_util: Dominant driver of the near-zero planning-eligible rate (0.012) -- affects 87.5% of the real LIVE campaign (every golden-reference incident) via two independent suppression gates simultaneously.
root_cause_ranking.remediation_cost: LOW -- use the same network-construction path (file-loaded .inp, matching what V4PipelineFactory already does in production) consistently at corpus-generation/calibration-fit time too, or normalize/round floats before hashing.
root_cause_ranking.regression_risk: LOW-MEDIUM -- requires re-fitting calibration/signature artifacts against the corrected hash, but does not touch model weights or fusion logic.
root_cause_ranking.likely_impact: Very high -- this alone plausibly recovers the overwhelming majority of the planning-eligibility gap for the single most-tested network.

root_cause_ranking.cause: Train/serve construction-path defects (CAP-PARITY-01 health-channel bug, CAP-PARITY-02 window_steps default)
root_cause_ranking.evidence_strength: High -- confirmed via direct tensor-level diffing against real production code on 20 fresh scenarios; CAP-PARITY-01 traced to a specific missing check in real, currently-deployed code.
root_cause_ranking.estimated_contribution_to_poor_live_util: Modest today (small cell counts, CAP-PARITY-02 rarely binds while evidence is already sparse) but would compound significantly if CAP-TEMPORAL-01 is fixed and incidents start carrying richer real evidence.
root_cause_ranking.remediation_cost: LOW -- both are small, localized code fixes.
root_cause_ranking.likely_impact: Low today, MEDIUM after CAP-TEMPORAL-01 is remediated -- should be fixed in the same remediation pass to avoid re-discovering it later.

root_cause_ranking.cause: Calibration Mondrian-key mismatch (CAP-CAL-02) and active-sampling observation-model mismatch (CAP-SAMPLE-01)
root_cause_ranking.evidence_strength: Medium-high -- both confirmed by direct source inspection and (for CAP-SAMPLE-01) a real empirical demonstration (recommended samples returning exactly 0.0 mg/L).
root_cause_ranking.estimated_contribution_to_poor_live_util: Secondary refinements: CAP-CAL-02 affects candidate-set precision only for the small fraction of incidents that already pass calibration; CAP-SAMPLE-01 affects the marginal value of the sampling loop, not initial localization.
root_cause_ranking.likely_impact: Low-Medium -- worth fixing but not blocking.

root_cause_ranking.cause: Fusion policy interactions (fusion 'harms' the correct component in 12.9% of LIVE incidents, dominated by classical-was-right-fusion-wrong rather than the protocol's warned-against neural-good/hybrid-bad pattern)
root_cause_ranking.evidence_strength: Medium -- real, measured (33/255 cases), but overall fusion regret vs best single component is small (-0.012) and classical-only performs far worse than neural-only in this LIVE dataset (0.176 vs 0.318), so fusion is not badly miscalibrated given how weak the classical branch already is under CAP-TEMPORAL-01/CAP-DATA-01's degraded evidence.
root_cause_ranking.estimated_contribution_to_poor_live_util: Small, and likely to shrink substantially once the two PRIMARY causes are fixed (classical localization quality is itself a downstream victim of sparse/mismatched evidence, not an independent fusion-logic defect).
root_cause_ranking.remediation_cost: MEDIUM if attempted now (risk of overfitting a fusion adjustment to symptoms of the primary causes).
root_cause_ranking.regression_risk: MEDIUM -- do not tune fusion before fixing CAP-TEMPORAL-01/CAP-DATA-01, or any tuning will be fit to the wrong regime.
root_cause_ranking.likely_impact: Low as an independent fix; re-evaluate AFTER primary fixes land.

root_cause_ranking.evidence_strength: High confidence this is NOT the primary bottleneck -- controlled reproduction exactly matches documented range, tensor forward passes are deterministic, oracle-prior substitution shows limited headroom (+0.10 top1) over an already-high full-trajectory baseline, and the LIVE gap is fully explained (with real causal experiments, not correlational ones) by evidence-content and construction-path issues that have nothing to do with parameter count.
root_cause_ranking.estimated_contribution_to_poor_live_util: Not supported by this diagnostic's evidence.
root_cause_ranking.remediation_cost: N/A -- no capacity-scaling pilot was run; per diagnostic.txt Section 40's own stated preconditions (train/serve parity must pass, evidence semantics must be matched, calibration/fusion must not be the main loss, neural-only must remain weak, capacity/underfitting must be indicated), NONE of the preconditions held after Sections 5-38, so running it would not have been diagnostically justified.
root_cause_ranking.likely_impact: Not supported; do not pursue before the PRIMARY/SECONDARY causes above are remediated and re-measured.

section_40_capacity_scaling_pilot.justification: diagnostic.txt Section 40 explicitly requires NOT running this automatically, only if diagnostics support a capacity bottleneck. Preconditions checked against real evidence: train/serve parity does NOT pass (CAP-PARITY-01/02 found); input/evidence semantics are NOT matched (CAP-TEMPORAL-01, CAP-DATA-01); calibration/fusion clearly ARE a large part of the performance loss (CAP-CAL-01/CAP-OOD-01 explain the suppression gap almost entirely); the model is not classified as underfit (model-capacity-diagnostics.json: DISTRIBUTION-SHIFTED). Zero of five stated preconditions were met -- skipped with justification, not fabricated.

section_41_data_diversity_pilot.justification: Requires 'topology transfer poor but in-topology performance good'. topology-analysis.json found the OPPOSITE pattern on a small sample (N=8/condition): branched-loop (a TRAINED family) scored top1=0.625, actually WORSE than coastal-branch (an UNTRAINED, unseen family) at top1=0.75 -- the precondition does not hold, and the small-sample noise plus the network-identity confound (CAP-DATA-01 likely also affects non-golden-reference topologies to a lesser degree, not fully characterized) make this an unreliable basis for a data-diversity pilot right now. Skipped with justification; flagged as worth re-checking AFTER CAP-DATA-01 is fixed, since the current topology comparison itself may be confounded by the same construction-path issue.
